summary.text: Mike Lajoie is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 96, Androscoggin County, representing Lewiston.
The page lists committee service on Criminal Justice and Public Safety.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Mike Lajoie's education as CMCC, SMCC (Associates, 1991).
The page lists Mike Lajoie's occupation as Retired Fire Chief.
The page lists military service: US Army Reserves.
Listed affiliations include Franco Center Lewiston, Knights of Columbus 10019, American Red Cross, Lewiston Fire Dept. 1970-2006, Lewiston City Council 2018-2019/2020-2021, Fishing, Hunting, Boating.
Mike Lajoie lives in Lewiston and has served 6 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Committee assignments listed: Leaves of Absence (chair); Criminal Justice and Public Safety (member).
Family details on the page: married, spouse Rita, 3 children, 5 grandchildren.
